This decline was fuelled by concerns over geopolitical unrest and comments from the US Federal Reserve hinting at delayed interest rate cuts. As the index dipped, the gold price sat in near-record territory on Apr 19 at US$2,390.86 per ounce. The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended the week at 37,986.40.
